label: scenario-calib
_why: Reference data for calibrating the balance UI's scenario panel against the game's own 1836 market. The comparison is: UI building inputs + pops vs (buy_orders - exports), and UI building outputs vs (sell_orders - imports) - pops never sell, so the supply side is a pop-free test of the building model. Read at DAY 0 (on_game_started_after_lobby), because by 1836.2.1 the AI's construction queue has already moved iron +25.7% and small arms -17.3% (probe 20260802_110757). Adds urban-centre levels and people-weighted SoL per stratum, neither of which is derivable from the game files, plus a full building inventory with employment at day 7.
